title: Eli Lilly easily tops quarterly estimates, raises outlook as Zepbound and Mounjaro sales surge
summary_full: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion and $85 billion.
summary_public: Eli Lilly now expects 2026 revenue to come in between $85 billion and $87 billion, up from a previous guidance of $82 billion and $85 billion.
